answer: Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Reaching the forge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the pulse of a task receipt, and the bridge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
